174043.description:
Two centuries have passed since a hero defeated the evil Jaryu and saved the world. In one of the many dungeon cities, Raust, a healer scorned and cast out of his party for being too weak, struggles to find his place. Amidst despair, he meets martial artist Narsena, who invites him to form a new party together. With a fresh start and renewed motivation, the two begin their journey to greatness.

He can't use a wand, but he can wield a sword in his battle to reach the top of a magic-dominated world. He just needs to believe in his own unique strengths and remember the promise he made with someone precious to him...

Thereafter, Yang Chen was determined to enhance his strength to protect his family, so he went alone to Mount Youyun to seek medicine. Eventually, he exposed the conspiracy and held onto the position of paterfamilias.

But after following some advice from a mysterious NewTube channel, Hobin is soon knocking out guys stronger than him and raking in more money than he could have ever dreamed of. Can Hobin keep this up, or will he eventually meet his match?

Despite her cool appearance of defeating demons, Shizuri is an otaku NEET who spends all her time playing video games. He avoids all danger and hides his strengths, practicing the art of escape while learning how to refine pill poison. Until one day, his master brings a female junior disciple back. Li Changshou, who only wants to cultivate himself in peace, is embroiled in a series of adventures.
